segments.name: Defense and Intelligence
segments.description: Provides national security solutions, including IT modernization, digital engineering and mission systems support, to the Defense Department and Intelligence Community.
segments.evidence: The Defense and Intelligence segment provides a diverse portfolio of national security solutions to the DoW and the Intelligence Community of the United States Government.

segments.name: Civilian
segments.description: Provides technology and mission support solutions to federal, state and local civilian agencies for citizen services, border security and public safety.
segments.evidence: The Civilian segment provides solutions to the civilian markets, encompassing federal, state, and local governments, in order to deliver services for citizen well-being, border security, and protecting lives.

revenueModel.text: U.S. government defense, intelligence and civilian agencies pay SAIC for technology integration, engineering, training and mission support services.
revenueModel.evidence: The offerings of both reportable segments entail the integration of emerging technologies into mission critical operations
